source.title: CEO-10 | Prepare AERLOR brand, claims and website commercial launch gate
source.body:
**Objective:** convert current truthful no-lead preview into a substantiated commercial site only after real supply and business identity exist.

**Acceptance:** independently clear name/trademark/domain; approve product render/photos matching actual model; validate retail reference pricing, country of origin and all performance claims; secure legal identity, privacy terms, real lead endpoint, tested form and delivery behavior, business contact details, approved price/stock/lead times; pass existing tests and LAUNCH.md.

**Do not** remove noindex or advertise availability/partners before gates. Do not change main website in this issue without reviewable PR. Reference PR #1 and LAUNCH.md.

comments.author: chriswong6031-creator
comments.text: **Brand status (2026-11-04):** domain provider previously reported aerlor.com available, **not registered**. General web checks did not establish full name clearance. USPTO [clearance guidance](https://www.uspto.gov/trademarks/search/comprehensive-clearance-search-similar-trademarks) requires related-goods and phonetically similar marks including common-law uses; CIPO/WIPO national screens and competent counsel remain outstanding. Do not claim registered trademark, legally cleared brand, Made in USA manufacture, consumer MSRP discount or product availability. Live site correctly remains a preview with no lead capture.

comments.author: mastermindxryan
comments.text:
## SITE-04 / R3 implementation and release evidence

Reviewed and merged PR #20. Final source: `68f0ba1a3ed6746551460d772cb791eb050ee988`; its tree is identical to reviewed hardening commit `7463cdf22712ecab950d872e4b0b2eb3478fc9dd`. The core R3 storefront was previously verified at `2d6d5fe47c9036d311622e0436ed0ca6878cf61c`.

### Delivered
- 33 semantic routes and six Lite/Premium hairdryer, illuminated-mirror and curler pages, with status-labelled specifications rather than fabricated production claims.
- Hotel/wholesale/group/designer storytelling, attributed independent guest anecdotes, comparison, pricing process, corporate/support/policy pages and a transparent room-budget calculator.
- Product-only project bag, quantities/finishes/bundles, real configured business-email drafts, complete downloadable project briefs, and server-gated checkout/order/webhook/inquiry adapters.
- Ten PDFs / 36 pages: lookbook, hotel business case, procurement guide, pilot toolkit and six specification briefs, all rendered from actual PDF bytes and visually reviewed.
- Vercel serves the application and APIs. GitHub Pages serves the separate non-transactional design/engineering showcase, not ecommerce.

### Verification
- Exact reviewed hardening commit: local build, 11 source contracts, 39 domain/server fixture tests, 63 Chromium browser checks, one intentionally skipped desktop copy of a mobile-only test.
- Actual core public storefront: 61 full Chromium checks plus two added blocked-font regression checks; full WebKit suite 63 passed, one intentionally skipped. WebKit is engine/emulation testing, not a physical iPhone test.
- Actual public contact workflow confirmed the configured business inbox and a reviewable email draft. Nothing was sent; zero form POSTs and no personal details in browser persistence.
- Real public PDFs, API config, 405 method boundaries, 404 return path and four viewport widths were verified. Provider fixture tests are not live merchant/database/email acceptance.
- Native Paper foundation remains 15 boards/3 pages/28 tokens. R3's 33 routes are not falsely represented as 33 newly created native Paper boards.

### Commercial activation remains open
No product is commercially released or priced; no live payments, direct server email, shipment, refund, domain or paid infrastructure purchase was performed. Before accepting money, approve exact products/specifications/market evidence, legal seller and correct merchant account, real price/stock, tax/shipping/support terms, fulfillment ownership and actual provider acceptance. The operational contract is in `docs/commerce/OPERATIONS.md`; disabled defaults are in `.env.example`.

This closes the website implementation/release scope, not the physical-product or merchant-activation workstreams. Keep the commercial launch gates visible rather than marking the business fully operational.

comments.author: mastermindxryan
comments.text:
## SITE-04 / R5 premium-technology release completed on the canonical site

**Released source:** [`887862f50f1d2444bfbf8b90df646290222713cf`](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/aerlor/commit/887862f50f1d2444bfbf8b90df646290222713cf), merged through PR #24. Public `https://aerlor.vercel.app/build-info.json` was read back and matched exactly. The canonical Vercel deployment is live; this is not only a preview deployment.

### Delivered
- Product-led graphite/white/metal identity, Inter typography and more direct copy across 33 semantic routes.
- Home, flagship product and hotel-buyer journey redesigned as a coherent decision path; six product pages preserve selection, specifications and procurement handoff.
- Native Paper page [`p-6-0`](https://app.paper.design/file/01M6JNN71ZN4867VJZ83PPXQZ0/p-6-0): **5 editable artboards / 530 nodes**; observed IDs, screenshots and JSX are in `design/precision-r5/`.
- Founder campaign assets integrated from PR #23's exact asset source without merging its conflicting legacy styles.
- 10 coordinated PDFs / 36 pages, rendered and visually reviewed.

### Verified against the public application
- Chromium: **59 passed**, one intentional desktop duplicate of the mobile-only navigation test skipped.
- WebKit: **59 passed**, same intentional skip. Browser emulation, not a physical iPhone test.
- Deployment checks: exact source identity, 1440/768/390/320 viewport layouts, product gallery, optional WebGL geometry inspection, nine key route fetches, all ten actual PDF assets and a real HTTP 404.
- Additional regression cases cover 820/1024 layouts; static audit checked 1,734 internal file and anchor references with zero broken targets.
- Actual, unmocked public inquiry workflow prepared an email draft addressed to the configured business inbox. No email was sent, no POST occurred and no personal form data was persisted.
- Source contracts: 14 passed. Server/domain provider-fixture tests: 39 passed; not live merchant acceptance.

### Separate publication / activation status
GitHub's hosted Actions jobs for the released SHA are still **queued**, including the R5 Pages showcase publication. [Exact run](https://github.com/mastermindx-market-intelligence/aerlor/actions/runs/41965167695). The public Pages showcase was observed still serving R3; no claim is made that R5 Pages or hosted CodeQL has completed.

The canonical storefront is verified independently of that queue. Checkout and direct server-side inquiry delivery remain disabled. No merchant activation, commercial prices, stock, production specifications, safety certifications or hotel customer results were invented by this design release.
